scripts.dev: npm run build -w @rf/contracts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n contracts,web,api "npm run dev -w @rf/contracts" "npm run dev -w @rf/web" "npm run dev -w @rf/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rf/contracts && npm run build -w @rf/api && npm run build -w @rf/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @rf/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @rf/api && npm run typecheck -w @rf/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @rf/contracts && npm run test -w @rf/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @rf/contracts && npm run db:seed -w @rf/api
